 Sofía Vergara may have a new man in her life, and his recent breakup with actress Minka Kelly is adding an unexpected twist to the romance rumors. 
 Over the weekend, the Modern Family star was spotted canoodling with Imagine Dragons singer Dan Reynolds at celebrity hotspot Cipriani in Beverly Hills, per TMZ . The duo was not alone, though; their late-night meal included the “Eyebrow Queen,” Anastasia Soare, founder of Anastasia Beverly Hills, and an unidentified man.
 The media outlet shared snapshots and video of their dinner with Vergara and Reynolds holding hands at one point — it was a flirty night out . They also noted that the 54-year-old actress and the 39-year-old musician “made a secret exit at one point… high-tailing it out the back door of the restaurant around 12:30 a.m.”
 Related story
 Joe Manganiello Has a Telling Update on His Relationship With Ex Sofía Vergara 
 Dan Reynolds and Minka Kelly at The MOCA Gala 2026 held at The Geffen Contemporary at MOCA on May 30, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. 
 Gilbert Flores/WWD 
 Reynolds dated Kelly for four years, with their last appearance together at the 2026 Museum of Contemporary Art (MOCA) Gala in May. The breakup happened somewhere between late September and early October, per People , which confirmed the couple’s split earlier this month.
 The Ransom Canyon star appeared to be in her feelings about the breakup when she buried a message about “soulmates” in an Instagram carousel on October 18.
 “Soulmates, or partners of destiny, can be people that come into your life and change your life,” reads the post. “And ideally, it’s not about holding on to it, but understanding what they brought into your life — what did you learn and how did you change? It’s about seeing these people and these situations as a gift, as steps in your own personal development.”
 Vergara has also had ex drama recently after Joe Manganiello published his memoir, Bloodlines , which followed not only his health journey, but also their seven-year marriage. He claims that after his near-fatal autoimmune disorder , the relationship became “devoid of any emotionality whatsoever.”
 Vergara’s son Manolo, 35, hit back with a message about the behavior of a “good man versus a narcissistic man” on his Instagram Story.
 “Remember kids, when dealing with a narcissist , it doesn’t matter how much you do for them, because they will resent you for it and nothing will ever be enough, and they’ll always somehow try to paint you as the bad guy,” he wrote in the post.
 Manganiello told Gayle King on the October 12 episode of CBS Mornings , “Well, I think anybody who said that should read the book first and understand what the book is actually about because it’s not about that. It’s about the suffering I went through.”
 Vergara and Reynolds have not spoken publicly about their night out together.
